title: Love in Limbo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Calen wakes in Limbo remembering only that he was a soldier, and is given a reaper's powers by God to atone for his sins by guiding and protecting the souls of the dead. He lives with Makoto, the pure-hearted caretaker of Limbo, and falls for him, then learns Makoto is a doll made of earth who will one day die and return to the land (SuBLime blurb via AniList, Simon & Schuster, MangaUpdates). MangaUpdates calls it a story of love through redemption, full of sadness.
life_message: Sin can be atoned for through faithful service, and love is worth having even when it cannot last.
